purpose: Teach: 山崎/藤原/松井/青山/坂本/近藤/石井/中島

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクトの主担当、山崎さんと藤原さんに決めた。
lines.en: I've decided on Yamazaki-san and Fujiwara-san as the project leads.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Even tempo, no rush. The tone of someone used to being heard. Slight pause after the decision lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サポートに松井さん、青山さん。
lines.en: Yes. Matsui-san and Aoyama-san on support.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Note-taking rhythm — precise, efficient. No flourish. The cadence of someone transcribing facts in real time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 坂本さん、近藤さんは、地域営業に回す。
lines.en: Sakamoto-san and Kondo-san go to regional sales.
lines.style: Flat direction. No inflection — this is how it is. Brief eye contact to signal movement to the next assignment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 石井さん、中島さんは、本社で経理を担当します。
lines.en: Ishii-san and Nakajima-san will handle accounting here at headquarters.
lines.style: Formal completion. Slight deference in the verb choice — he's stating facts for the record. Crisp finish, no trailing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Brief nod of finality. Slight rise at the end — permission and dismissal in one. The sound of a meeting wrapping up.
